ayahs.textEnglish: WHEN GOD'S SUCCOUR comes, and victory,

ayahs.textArabic: وَرَاَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُوْنَ فِيْ دِيْنِ اللّٰهِ اَفْوَاجًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ra'aitan-nāsa yadkhulūna fī dīnillāhi afwājā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and thou seest people enter God's religion in hosts,

ayahs.textArabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُۗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ تَوَّابًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wastagfirh(u), innahū kāna tawwābā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: extol thy Sustainer's limitless glory, and praise Him, and seek His forgiveness: for, behold, He is ever an acceptor of repentance.
